en: Suddenly, you felt as if your body had grown lighter.{w}
note: Generic event result (127 dupes); 'you' = the party, as in kimitachi narration elsewhere.

en: This is an altar tied to the Stairway of Light.{w}Hemaid Red Stone has been offered here.{w}
note: 'hikari no kaidan' -> 'Stairway of Light' (wmap slices 02/09; wmap slice_01 used 'Stair of Light' -- unify). Item name as in wmap slice_01 ITEM_PRIZ 'Hemaid's Red Stone' (wmap slice_09 has 'Hemaid Red Stone' -- unify).

en: There is something like an altar here.{w}In its center is a hollow; something seems to have been set into it once.{w}{p}Looking around, this altar appears to be just one part of a larger altar.{w}The center of this group of altars must lie to the south.{w}{p}Something is written on the altar in weathered letters.{w}
note: kubomi -> 'hollow' as in wmap slice_09 (the three altars' hollows).

Altar inscription (not an echo of the previous row). 'genseki' -> 'Phantom Stone' (wmap slice_01/02); wmap slice_09 used 'Mystic Stone' -- unify. Full-width centering spaces replaced with ASCII spaces.

Before you is a spring brimming with green water.{w}

en:
There's no one here now.
The secret door has already been opened.{w}

note: New name: Taaritto romanized 'Tarrit'. A Valkyrie girl (row 148 shoujo; calls herself onna no ko in row 143).
She can no longer resist the fruity smell (rows 124, 149). Tarrit's drawn-out vowel endings rendered with stretched words and '~' (used for similar voices in pilot/wmap).
ei = effort shout as she lunges into the crack.

en: The girl tried to force her way into the crack in the wall.{w}
note: 'her': the source itself calls Tarrit shoujo (girl) here and in row 133, and Tarrit says onna no ko of herself (row 143).
unsho = straining grunt; gyumu-gyumu = squeezing; meki-meki = creaking/cracking.
Name box while she is inside the crack (14 chars).
Music-note symbol dropped (ASCII only); '~' carries the cheerful tone. 'Nnoh?' = her puzzled noise, kept as a sound.
kore wa, masaka = she realizes she is stuck.
Struggling noises, same sound as row 124's 'Nnoh'.

en: Right in front of you, a butt is wriggling and flailing about.{w}
note: shiri = butt; comic register kept.
Source has a stray space before the final {w}; dropped.

en: The crack crumbled away, and a path opened up.{w}

"I'm saaaved~.{w}Thank you, thank you veeery much~."{w}{p}"So that makes us acquaintances now, master~.{w}Traveling alone is all kinds of tough,
so hang out with me now and then~."{w}
note: aruji -> 'master': Tarrit addresses the party as aruji (lord/master), a playful honorific. Doubled 'gozaimasu' -> 'thank you, thank you veeery much'. kamatte ne -> 'hang out with me / give me some attention'.
sakaba no tsuke = her bar tab (tavern not named).

en: The girl went on her way, beaming and giggling "ehehe."{w}
note: ehe-ehe hohoemi = grinning with 'ehehe' giggles.

en: You gave it your best shot.{w}
note: Branch result; script order puts it right before her 'gentler' complaint (row 135), so it is probably the Help or Dropkick result -- 'best shot' fits either reading.
New item name: subarashii ukon -> 'Wonderful Turmeric' (ITEM_PRIZ 35, the Tarrit event item; also named in EVENT_TEXT 79). Turmeric is a Japanese hangover remedy -- likely tied to her tavern tab.
uhaa (her tic) -> 'Uwaaah'; probably after choosing Leave.

en: You steadied your breathing and formed a hand seal.{w}A hush fell over the area, and the waves in your heart grew still.{w}
note: in wo musubu = form a (ninja) hand seal; ITEM_TEXT says the Three-Year Death technique starts with a fingertip seal.
hissatsu banner (not an echo); ASCII spaces for centering.
Her shriek on being jabbed.
chotto matsu (odd plain form, her quirk) -> 'Hold it right there.'

en:
Tarrit pulled free of the crack unaided
and stared at you, clearly displeased.{w}

"Weeell, that's really going too far, y'know~.{w}Something this awful, even a gentle soul like me won't forgive.{w}No weird pranks on girls, got it?"{w}{p}"Hmph, hmph... Okay, take two...{w}Heave, heave..."{w}
note: punsuka = huffy-anger mimetic -> 'Hmph, hmph'. shikiri naoshite = starting over (sumo term) -> 'take two'.

en: Tarrit crouched down and got stuck in the crack all over again.{w}
"Uaaah, I can't get out~, I can't go forward~."{w}{p}"...Huh?{w}Didn't I just get myself out a second ago...?{w}Huh? Huh? Huuuh???"{w}{p}"Oh well, whatever.{w}Anyway, heeelp meee~."{w}
note: areeere = escalating confusion.

en: "Uuu. Maybe I'll keep at it a little longer~."{w}
note: Probably her line after the party chooses Leave.
Speaker shown as ??? (name not yet given); it is Tarrit (row 149).

en: A Valkyrie girl is peering into a crack in the wall in front of you, looking troubled.{w}
note: Valkyrie = character class.

en:
"Oh. Well, well, adventurers~.
...I'm an adventurer too, y'know~.
The name's Tarrit~."{w}{p}"There's a crack right here, see,
and a nice fruity smell's coming from the other side~.{w}There's gotta be some yummy fruit or nuts over there~."{w}
note: ki no mi = nuts/berries/tree fruit -> 'fruit or nuts'.
jururi = drooling sound.

en: "But I can't get through a gap this narrow~.{w}Uwaaah, what do I dooo~."{w}

"A crack like this, I'd love to jab it with my spear
and pry it wide open~."{w}
note: oppiroge = spread wide open (slightly crude); kept blunt.

en:
It looked like a secret door,
but the gap didn't seem like it would open.{w}

note: sannen-goroshi: the joke 'killing technique' (a fingertip jab up the backside; per ITEM_TEXT, named for a rumor that losers died three years later). Also an item name in ITEM.CSV (max 20) -- keep the two the same.
Reused from wmap slice_04 (menu choice).

en: There is a weather-beaten signpost here.{w}
note: amazarashi = exposed to the rain. Next row (slice_003 row 160) asks 'Read it?'.
